mapper.select: SELECT t.* FROM tasks t WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.is_deleted = FALSE AND (t.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR t.description ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC
